newsitem.title: USA: Aristar files shelf for $800 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Aristar files shelf for $800 mln in debt.

text.p: Aristar Inc, a unit of Great Western Financial Corp, filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday to sell up to $800 million in debt securities.
When combined with a previous registration, Aristar will have a total offering of $850 million in debt securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to reduce borrowings and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.

On March 6 Great Western and Washington Mutual Inc, a financial services company, announced that they had entered into an agreement and plan of merger providing for the merger of Great Western with and into a subsidiary of Washington Mutual.
Subject to regulatory approval, the merger is expected to be consummated in the third quarter of 1997, the filing said.
